page.overview:
What is Corcoran Highland Goat?

The Corcoran Highland Goat was a proprietary species of large domesticated goat that the Weyland-Yutani Corporation used on off-world colonies as beasts of burden and to perform tasks for humans. They were taller than the average adult human male.

A herd of the goats were used as hosts by the species on the colony vessel Hadley, producing a unique caste of Xenomorph.
